confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded from undated cost-of-living aggregators (citycost-style Zermatt and Zurich figures, Zurich city guides) and a 2025 Zermatt luxury-hotel bar menu, so they are rough. Cocktail and wine are partly inferred from the local beer relationship, since direct Zermatt prices for mainstream bars were thin. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July high season, not checked against live listings or current rates. Swiss francs were converted at an assumed ~1.25 USD per CHF that I did not verify by search. FX: the RBA exchange-rates table lists 0.6947 for 16 Oct 2026, but RBA summary pages show 0.6955 for 15 Oct, and I could not open the F11/F11.1 data file to confirm the latest row.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a premium Swiss mountain resort: restaurant and drink anchors use Zurich-based Swiss cost ranges and Zermatt-specific menu and aggregator figures, with a resort premium applied. Accommodation is a model estimate for a Zermatt summer peak, benchmarked loosely against other Swiss alpine resort towns.
